body.name: Definition 3.14 baseline-path class \(\mathsf H_{\mathrm{obs}}(G)\)
body.construction: \(\mathsf H_{\mathrm{obs}}(G)=\{G':\overline{G'}=\overline G,\ \operatorname{rank}P[R_j,C_j]=\operatorname{rank}P[R_j,C_j\cup\{j\}]\text{ for every }j\in V\text{ and every }\theta\in\mathcal M^{\circ}_{\mathrm{term},p,q}(G,G')\}\).
